```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(grid)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

# Layout parameters

Cell size drives everything. Label size is capped by cell size, so set the cell
size first and let the font follow.

`label_pt` must stay below about 0.85 x cell size in points, otherwise adjacent
tick labels touch. 1 mm = 2.845 pt.

```{r params}
cell_mm  <- 2.8   # heatmap cell edge, identical in both panels
label_pt <- 7     # isolate tick labels
legend_pt <- 10   # legend and colour bar text

text_width_mm  <- 160   # A4 portrait, 25 mm margins
text_height_mm <- 247

# Fixed overhead per panel, left to right
dend_mm  <- 12   # row dendrogram
anno_mm  <- 3    # species strip
names_mm <- 8    # isolate tick labels
slack_mm <- 3    # inter-element gaps

cell_pt <- cell_mm * 2.845
if (label_pt > 0.85 * cell_pt) {
  warning(sprintf(
    "label_pt = %.1f exceeds 0.85 x cell (%.1f pt). Labels will crowd.",
    label_pt, 0.85 * cell_pt
  ))
}
```

# Input

```{r input}
file_A <- "all_IncN_distances_with_species.tsv"      # panel A, was Fig3A
file_B <- "inclm_plasmids_distances_with_species.tsv" # panel B, was Fig4A
```

# Shared species palette

Both panels share one legend, so the palette is the union of the species present
in either dataset. Names are drawn in italics in the legend.

```{r palette}
species_cols <- c(
  "C. freundii"   = "#66c2a5",
  "E. coli"       = "#fc8d62",
  "K. aerogenes"  = "#8da0cb",
  "K. pneumoniae" = "#e78ac3",
  "E. cloacae"    = "#a6d854",
  "K. oxytoca"    = "#ffd92f",
  "H. alvei"      = "#80b1d3",
  "S. marcescens" = "#c2a36b"
)
```

# Label parsing

The two TSVs encode species differently, so each panel keeps its own parser.

Panel A previously mapped `senterica_achtman_2` to *S. enterica*. That was an
MLST scheme name reported for an isolate that is *E. coli*, so it now maps to
*E. coli*. This and the two per-isolate overrides below are corrections applied
downstream of the typing step. Fixing them in the upstream species table and
keeping this script as a pure plotting step would be preferable.

```{r parsers}
species_map_A <- c(
  "cfreundii"           = "C. freundii",
  "ecloacae"            = "E. cloacae",
  "ecoli_achtman_4"     = "E. coli",
  "escherichia_coli"    = "E. coli",
  "kaerogenes"          = "K. aerogenes",
  "klebsiella"          = "K. pneumoniae",
  "koxytoca"            = "K. oxytoca",
  "senterica_achtman_2" = "E. coli",
  "-"                   = NA_character_
)

short_label_A <- function(x) {
  n <- str_match(x, "isolate_([0-9]+)")[, 2]
  n[is.na(n)] <- x[is.na(n)]
  n
}

extract_species_A <- function(x) {
  raw <- str_match(x, "\\(([^()]*)\\)$")[, 2]
  out <- ifelse(!is.na(raw) & raw %in% names(species_map_A),
                species_map_A[raw], raw)
  n <- str_match(x, "isolate_([0-9]+)")[, 2]
  out[n == "6813"] <- "H. alvei"
  out[n == "7454"] <- "E. coli"
  out
}

short_label_B <- function(x) str_match(x, "isolate_([0-9]+)")[, 2]

extract_species_B <- function(x) {
  s <- str_match(x, "\\[([^\\[\\]]*)\\]$")[, 2]
  s[s == "Unknown"] <- NA_character_
  n <- str_match(x, "isolate_([0-9]+)")[, 2]
  s[n == "7077"] <- "S. marcescens"
  s
}
```

# Matrix builder

```{r builder}
build_matrix <- function(path, short_fun, species_fun) {
  d <- read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  req <- c("plasmid_1_labeled", "plasmid_2_labeled", "distance")
  miss <- setdiff(req, names(d))
  if (length(miss) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(miss, collapse = ", ")))
  }

  d <- d %>%
    mutate(
      s1 = short_fun(plasmid_1_labeled),
      s2 = short_fun(plasmid_2_labeled),
      sp1 = species_fun(plasmid_1_labeled),
      sp2 = species_fun(plasmid_2_labeled)
    )

  labs <- sort(unique(c(d$s1, d$s2)))

  long <- d %>% select(row = s1, col = s2, distance)

  sym <- bind_rows(
    long,
    long %>% rename(row = col, col = row),
    tibble(row = labs, col = labs, distance = 0)
  ) %>%
    distinct(row, col, .keep_all = TRUE)

  m <- sym %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = distance) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  rownames(m) <- m$row
  m$row <- NULL
  m <- as.matrix(m)[labs, labs]

  if (any(is.na(m))) {
    stop("Distance matrix contains missing pairwise comparisons. Do not impute.")
  }

  sp <- bind_rows(
    d %>% transmute(short = s1, species = sp1),
    d %>% transmute(short = s2, species = sp2)
  ) %>%
    distinct(short, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    filter(short %in% rownames(m)) %>%
    arrange(match(short, rownames(m)))

  unknown <- setdiff(na.omit(unique(sp$species)), names(species_cols))
  if (length(unknown) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Species not in palette:", paste(unknown, collapse = ", ")))
  }

  list(mat = m, species = setNames(sp$species, sp$short))
}

A <- build_matrix(file_A, short_label_A, extract_species_A)
B <- build_matrix(file_B, short_label_B, extract_species_B)
```

# Diagnostics

Check these before trusting the figure.

```{r diagnostics}
cat("Panel A:", nrow(A$mat), "plasmids\n")
cat("Panel B:", nrow(B$mat), "plasmids\n")

table(A$species, useNA = "ifany")
table(B$species, useNA = "ifany")

# Isolates reassigned from the S. enterica MLST scheme to E. coli
d_check <- read_tsv(file_A, show_col_types = FALSE)
d_check %>%
  filter(str_detect(plasmid_1_labeled, "senterica")) %>%
  transmute(isolate = short_label_A(plasmid_1_labeled)) %>%
  distinct()

# Width budget
for (nm in c("A", "B")) {
  n <- nrow(get(nm)$mat)
  total <- dend_mm + anno_mm + names_mm + slack_mm + n * cell_mm
  cat(sprintf("Panel %s: body %.0f mm, total %.0f mm of %.0f mm available\n",
              nm, n * cell_mm, total, text_width_mm))
  if (total > text_width_mm) warning(sprintf("Panel %s exceeds text width.", nm))
}
```

# Colour scale

Both panels use one scale, defined in `fig4_scale.R`: 0 to the largest distance
in either panel, white at the pling subcommunity threshold of 4.

```{r scales}
source("fig4_scale.R")
col_A <- fig4_col_fun
col_B <- fig4_col_fun
```

# Build panels

Column tick labels and the column dendrogram are dropped. The matrix is
symmetric and the same tree is used on both axes, so they carry no information
the row side does not already carry, and removing them frees height.

```{r panels}
make_panel <- function(x, col_fun, name) {
  tree <- hclust(as.dist(x$mat), method = "average")
  n <- nrow(x$mat)

  ra <- rowAnnotation(
    species = x$species,
    col = list(species = species_cols),
    simple_anno_size = unit(anno_mm, "mm"),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    show_legend = FALSE,
    na_col = "#ffffff"
  )

  ca <- columnAnnotation(
    species = x$species,
    col = list(species = species_cols),
    simple_anno_size = unit(anno_mm, "mm"),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    show_legend = FALSE,
    na_col = "#ffffff"
  )

  Heatmap(
    x$mat,
    name = name,
    col = col_fun,
    cluster_rows = tree,
    cluster_columns = tree,
    row_dend_reorder = FALSE,
    column_dend_reorder = FALSE,
    row_split = 4,
    column_split = 4,
    row_title = NULL,
    column_title = NULL,
    row_gap = unit(0.6, "mm"),
    column_gap = unit(0.6, "mm"),
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    row_names_side = "right",
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = label_pt),
    show_row_dend = TRUE,
    show_column_dend = FALSE,
    row_dend_width = unit(dend_mm, "mm"),
    left_annotation = ra,
    top_annotation = ca,
    width = unit(n * cell_mm, "mm"),
    height = unit(n * cell_mm, "mm"),
    rect_gp = gpar(col = NA),
    border = FALSE,
    show_heatmap_legend = FALSE
  )
}

ht_A <- make_panel(A, col_A, "dist_A")
ht_B <- make_panel(B, col_B, "dist_B")
```

# Legends

```{r legends}
lgd_dist <- do.call(Legend, c(list(col_fun = fig4_col_fun), fig4_legend_param(legend_pt)))

lgd_sp <- Legend(
  labels = names(species_cols),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = species_cols),
  title = "Species",
  nrow = 2,
  grid_height = unit(3.5, "mm"),
  grid_width = unit(3.5, "mm"),
  title_gp = gpar(fontsize = legend_pt, fontface = "plain"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = legend_pt, fontface = "italic")
)

lgd_all <- packLegend(lgd_dist, lgd_sp,
                     direction = "horizontal",
                     column_gap = unit(6, "mm"))
```

# Assemble and write

Panel heights are set from the computed body sizes so both panels are drawn at
the same cell size rather than stretched to equal width.

```{r assemble}
h_A <- nrow(A$mat) * cell_mm + anno_mm + 8
h_B <- nrow(B$mat) * cell_mm + anno_mm + 8
h_L <- 22
fig_h <- h_A + h_B + h_L + 10

cat(sprintf("Figure height %.0f mm of %.0f mm available\n",
            fig_h, text_height_mm))

draw_figure <- function() {
  grid.newpage()
  pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(
    nrow = 3, heights = unit(c(h_A, h_B, h_L), "mm")
  )))

  pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 1))
  draw(ht_A, newpage = FALSE, padding = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "mm"))
  grid.text("A", x = unit(1, "mm"), y = unit(1, "npc") - unit(1, "mm"),
            just = c("left", "top"), gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))
  popViewport()

  pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 2))
  draw(ht_B, newpage = FALSE, padding = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "mm"))
  grid.text("B", x = unit(1, "mm"), y = unit(1, "npc") - unit(1, "mm"),
            just = c("left", "top"), gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))
  popViewport()

  pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 3))
  draw(lgd_all, x = unit(0.5, "npc"), y = unit(0.5, "npc"))
  popViewport()

  popViewport()
}

draw_figure()
```

```{r write-files}
mm_to_in <- function(x) x / 25.4

pdf("Fig4_IncN_IncLM_DCJ_indel_panels.pdf",
    width = mm_to_in(text_width_mm + 6),
    height = mm_to_in(fig_h + 6),
    useDingbats = FALSE)
draw_figure()
dev.off()

png("Fig4_IncN_IncLM_DCJ_indel_panels.png",
    width = text_width_mm + 6, height = fig_h + 6,
    units = "mm", res = 600)
draw_figure()
dev.off()
```
